AssayDetails: This was a balanced and double blind study with 4 weeks of product application and 1 week of regression, involving four cells of acne subjects. Meanwhile, one cell of non-acne subjects were enrolled to provide reference for microbiome. The test products were applied twice a day (morning and evening). The evaluation time points were screening (Week -1), Baseline (Week 0), Day 1, Day 3, Week 1, Week 2, Week 4, and Regression Week 1.
objectives: To evaluate anti-acne benefit of the cleansers and regime (cleanser plus moisturizer) containing the active over 4 weeks of product application by dermatologist live visual assessments, including acne lesion types and counts of each type
